subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the first Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first **Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav** was held in the year **2023**.
 
• The event aims to promote sports and physical activities among the tribal communities in India.
 
• It serves as a platform for showcasing the talent of tribal athletes and encourages greater participation in sports.</li&
